subject: Request for post-audit assurance memorandum — Orbitalsys
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@orbitalsys.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: security@orbitalsys.com
Date: 2026-11-15T16:12:00Z
Subject: Post-audit assurance memo request (Orbitalsys)

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick ramp on the SIG follow-up last week. Our procurement and security teams are working through a gating item for Orbitalsys' renewal: we need a short formal assurance memo from Redwood that covers the period after your last SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2024-12-31) up to today.

Specifically they asked for:
- A signed statement confirming there have been no material control changes since 2024-12-31, or a summary of any changes that could affect confidentiality or availability controls.
- Confirmation of the date range the SOC 2 report covers and a line noting whether any compensating controls are in place for changes since the report end date.
- Name and title of the person authorized to sign such a memo.

I've attached our draft request and a copy of the SIG response for context. Can Redwood provide this assurance memo (we call it an "assurance memorandum") or an equivalent bridge/attestation letter by EOD Wednesday? If you have a standard template we can accept, that would be ideal.

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Claire
Claire Hsu
Security Program Manager
Orbitalsys

Attachments: Draft_Assurance_Memo_Request.docx (docx), Orbitalsys_SIG_Response_2026.pdf (pdf)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
To: Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@orbitalsys.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-16T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-audit assurance memo request (Orbitalsys)

Hi Claire —

Thanks for sending the request and context. We can provide an assurance memorandum that summarizes the SOC 2 period and confirms the absence of material control changes since 2024-12-31, or call out any control updates with mitigation descriptions.

A couple quick clarifying questions before we issue the memo:
1) Do you need the memo to be notarized or on letterhead only?
2) Is Orbitalsys OK with a Redwood-signed internal attestation (from Head of Compliance) rather than an external auditor-signed addendum?
3) Would a one-page memo + excerpt from our internal change log suffice, or do you need a longer narrative for each control domain?

Jonas — looping you in for legal signatory guidance. Marissa, tagging you for approval on the attestation language (I drafted a concise template). I've attached our SOC 2 Type II report for reference and a first-pass memo draft.

Proposed next steps:
- Confirm preferred signatory and notarization requirement by EOD tomorrow.
- If agreed, we can deliver a signed assurance memorandum by 2026-11-18.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Report_Redwood_2024-12-31.pdf (pdf), Draft_Assurance_Memo_Request.docx (docx)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, Claire Hsu <claire.hsu@orbitalsys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-17T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-audit assurance memo request (Orbitalsys)

Claire / Priya —

We can proceed with Redwood issuing a one-page assurance memorandum on company letterhead, signed by Marissa Cole (Head of Compliance). Notarization is not required for Orbitalsys' procurement policy per my review — a signed attestation is sufficient. The memo will:
- Restate the SOC 2 Type II report coverage dates (period ending 2024-12-31).
- Confirm that no material control changes impacting confidentiality, integrity, or availability have occurred since the report end date through 2026-11-17, except for two routine infrastructure upgrades in 2025 which introduced additional monitoring and a compensating review process (we will include a one-sentence summary).
- Provide contact for follow-up and reference to the SOC 2 report.

Priya: please finalize the one-paragraph language on the two upgrades and attach the excerpt from the change log. I'll route the final PDF to Marissa for signature today. Claire: expect the signed memo by 2026-11-17 EOD.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Quoted text from earlier: "Thanks for the quick ramp on the SIG follow-up last week..."
